title: Waitlist from a cold list
bring: Waitlist export with one row per sign-up
pass_hint: at least 30 sign-ups from 300 cold contacts

title: Paid pre-sale at list price
bring: Checkout export showing payer count and price
pass_hint: at least 3 of 10 qualified prospects pay

title: One paid channel test
bring: Ad or outreach export with spend, clicks and sign-ups
pass_hint: cost per sign-up under the planned acquisition cost

title: Product usage analytics
bring: Analytics export of active users by week
pass_hint: at least 40% of sign-ups active in week two

title: Paid pilot invoice
bring: A paid invoice at the intended price
pass_hint: one customer pays the full intended price

title: Signed letter of intent
bring: A letter of intent signed by a qualified buyer
pass_hint: at least 2 signed letters at the planned price

title: Supplier letter of intent
bring: A letter of intent signed by a supplier
pass_hint: at least 3 suppliers commit to list

title: Repeat purchase cohort
bring: Orders export showing customers who bought twice
pass_hint: at least 30% of first buyers buy again

title: Working prototype run
bring: A write-up of the prototype doing the core job end to end
pass_hint: the prototype completes the core job for a real input

title: Unit economics model
bring: A model with each cost line and its source
pass_hint: a positive margin at the tested price

title: Delivery hours log
bring: Hours per engagement, or a handoff record
pass_hint: the work fits the planned hours without the founder

title: Compliance or professional memo
bring: A memo naming the rule, the path and its cost
pass_hint: a named path exists with cost and time
